name: Mental Breakdown Minnesota 2022
information: This competition WILL NOT have the normal 3x3x3 Speedsolving Event. If you are looking for a competition with more regular events, please see either [NxN Minnesota 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNMinnesota2022) or [Side Events Minnesota 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SideEventsMinnesota2022). This competition is NOT part of the series with [NxN Minnesota 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNMinnesota2022) and [Side Events Minnesota 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SideEventsMinnesota2022). Anybody competing in that series is eligible to compete in this competition as well.
